top_categories.workout_context: When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Gran Fondo Collado del Condor's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before March.
Gran Fondo Collado del Condor's mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 76 miles.
Gran Fondo Collado del Condor's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
At Gran Fondo Collado del Condor, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Gran Fondo Collado del Condor. Train it until it feels boring.
76 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Base fitness for Gran Fondo Collado del Condor. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Gran Fondo Collado del Condor, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Gran Fondo Collado del Condor's mixed terrain actually does to you.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Gran Fondo Collado del Condor’s 76 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.altitude: Gran Fondo Collado del Condor demands altitude preparation. Arrive 5–7 days early for acclimatization. Expect 5–15% power reduction at altitude. Increase iron intake 4 weeks out. Hydrate aggressively — altitude increases fluid loss by 20–40%.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Gran Fondo Collado del Condor requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, Race Simulation, and Road Specific to prepare you for 76 miles of mixed terrain in Merida, Venezuela.
